changes.title: Exact run records
changes.text: Single-run reports and linked records no longer mix distinct run identifiers that differ only by letter case.

changes.title: CSV report completeness
changes.text: CSV reports now disclose when their existing large-table limit leaves entries out, matching the other export formats.

changes.title: Record links and exports
changes.text: Added case-sensitive report and navigation regressions, CSV completeness checks and native Android link-touch coverage.

changes.title: Verification records
changes.text: Recorded the preceding APK's successful checks and the next audit corrections without changing saved player data.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I corrected run navigation that could mix case-distinct identifiers and made incomplete CSV reports say so. Existing player text searches and recorded data remain intact.
